# Chisan

> Connecting local food.

Chisan is a public discovery catalog for place-based food and drink producers. It helps people find and understand productive units by country, catalog area and category while keeping published facts stable, reviewable and traceable.

## When to use Chisan

Use Chisan when someone wants to discover food or drink producers rooted in a specific place, understand what a producer makes, open the producer's official channels, or compare public catalog coverage across areas.

Do not treat Chisan as a complete census, a producer quality ranking, a marketplace, or proof that an unlisted producer is ineligible. Catalog coverage grows through source-backed research and reviewed contributions.

## How the catalog works

- One public profile represents one productive unit.
- Area CSV files are the source of truth for published producer facts.
- Evidence records the sources and reasons behind reviewed decisions.
- Account ownership authorizes a proposal, not its facts.
- Corrections and producer requests are reviewed before publication.
- No deployed request writes directly to the public CSV catalog.

## Key public pages

- Home and producer catalog: https://chisan.app/
- How Chisan works: https://chisan.app/how-we-work
- Contact: https://chisan.app/contact
- Privacy and cookies: https://chisan.app/privacy
- Current sitemap shard: https://chisan.app/sitemap/0.xml

## Access and technical scope

Public catalog pages can be read without an account. Chisan does not currently expose a public producer-catalog API, OpenAPI specification or MCP server. Use the public HTML pages and canonical sitemap to discover catalog content.
